items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: So we went up there and had dinner. Then they asked me to sit in with them and play somethin'. So I got in and played three or four numbers.

ctx.x: We went to Minneapolis and played the dates/the bass(?) there, and we got through playing that night, and we went down where Lester was playing with Frank Hine and Eddie Barefield. It was about seven or eight pieces. So we went up there, and they played until I guess two or three or four o'clock in the morning. Anyway, we went up there and had dinner. Then they asked me to sit in with them and play somethin'. So I got in and played three or four numbers. So we...
Now, just a minute. Lester was playing alto then or tenor?
